name: City Council Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 26, 2022 6:30 p.m.
  Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
  12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be summarized during the meeting.

  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:

  The Public may join this meeting virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

  Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, City Council members and staff may be participating in
  this meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(e).

  Please click the link below to join the meeting:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81136221545
  Webinar ID: 811 3622 1545
  One tap mobile:
  +16699009128,,81136221545# or +16694449171,,81136221545#
  Telephone:
  : +1 669 900 9128 or +1 669 444 9171 or +1 346 248 7799 or +1 719 359 4580
  Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor.

  In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
  modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services,
  please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and distributed
  by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public inspection at
  City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.
 CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers McSweeney, Honig, Davis, Mayor Pro Tem
  Pearl, Mayor Halpern

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes from September 28, 2022 Study Session, September 28, 2022 City Council
Regular Meeting, and October 3, 2022 Closed Session.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the printed
agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page 1
of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to
the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Chamber of Commerce Report

4.  Library Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None
Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PUBLIC HEARING FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT NO. 22-003;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2276-22 - Adopt Resolution No. 2276-22, approving Planned
  Development Permit No. 22-003, authorizing the construction of a 1,670 sq. ft.
  addition of habitable space, a 288 sq. ft. garage addition, a 586 sq. ft. new front
  porch, and an interior and exterior remodel of a residence located at 31868 Foxfield
  Drive.
 MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective October 15, ,2022, in the amount
  of $472,834.94

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  APPROVAL OF CONTRACT WITH MUNICODE FOR MUNICIPAL CODE
  SUPPLEMENTATION/CODIFICATION AND LEGAL REVIEW - Approval of
  an agreement with Municode for yearly supplementation/codification services
  for the Municipal Code and a one-time legal review, and that the City Manager
  be authorized to execute the contract and statement of work on behalf of the
  City.

OLD BUSINESS: None

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  CONSIDERATION OF A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH THE
  CLEAN POWER ALLIANCE TO PARTICIPATE IN THE POWER READY
  PROGRAM - Authorize the Mayor to execute the Memorandum of Understanding
  with the Clean Power Alliance of Southern California to participate and enroll the
  Westlake Village Civic Center in the Clean Power Alliance’s Power Ready Program.

ADJOURNMENT:
This agenda was posted on Thursday, October 20 at 6:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the Posting Board
at City Hall. To access Agenda and Staff Reports go to www.wlv.org and click on “City Council Agendas,
Minutes & Video”. City Council meetings can be seen live on WVTV Channel 10 or via web streaming on
www.wlv.org.
